content.title: Court Records Request Information
content.summary: To obtain court records for cases within the last four years, individuals must complete a Court Records Request Form and pay a $5 fee for a basic background check, along with any additional fees for more extensive research. If no record exists or the case is older than four years, the court can issue a letter confirming the absence of a record.
content.body:
You might need to obtain information of previous Court cases for the following reasons:

- Military
- Other Judicial Branches
- Employment
- Gaming License
- Other

Court records are kept for four years. To obtain a certified copy of a previous Court case within the last four years you must:

- Submit a completed [Court Records Request Form](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/32711)
- Pay $5 for a basic background check
- Pay additional fees detailed in the [Administrative Fee Schedule (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/363) if more in-depth research is required

If there is no record on file and/or the case is more than four years old, the court can provide a letter stating that the court no longer has a record.
